policy.objective: Raw scalar objectives under different weights are not ranked.
policy.rule: Joint acceptance first; otherwise componentwise physical comparison.
policy.tradeoff: Any physical improvement accompanied by physical worsening is a trade-off, not overall improvement.

coverage.definition: Both endpoints, timestamps aligned to task sample_period_s; missing samples are unavailable, never a pass.

position.definition: Maximum sampled world tip position error in the final interval.

speed.definition: Maximum sampled world tip translational speed norm in the final interval.

control/recipe/terminal_tip_speed_weight.description: Dimensionless terminal weight on squared world tip speed / tip_speed_scale_m_s. Zero preserves legacy cost.

decision.reasoning: The current feedback is confined to the frozen compliant shortened structure (structure a6099...; near 0.16, far 0.11, section 0.95). At fixed terminal weight 0.05 the holding speed jumps from a pass at holding 0.05 (~0.0127 m/s, F513/F353 class) to a fail at holding 0.06 (0.023994623331658485, F437/F280) and stays failing for 0.075/0.09/0.10 holding (F375/F319 = 0.02260458517372844 for the source 0.09/0.05). Yet the SAME holding 0.09 passes once terminal weight is raised to 0.10 (0.010201160469407439, F258/F360, holding_speed_passed true F328). So the recorded pattern is compatibly explained by a terminal×holding weight interaction rather than a fixed holding threshold, while two named alternatives remain untested: solver-plan selection (no repeated execution of any identical configuration exists — the sharp near-factor-2 jump could be a discrete plan switch) and structural sensitivity (all samples share one structure identity). Budget allows exactly one more batch with at most two backend attempts. The cheapest discriminatory pair is (i) an explicit re-execution of the frozen source (holding 0.09, terminal 0.05) to test run-to-run reproducibility, and (ii) one novel intermediate terminal weight (holding 0.09, terminal 0.075) at fixed holding to test whether the terminal-weight rescue is graded or discrete. This keeps holding fixed, changes only the terminal weight, references the first-batch evidence directly, and does not attempt the structurally confounded route.
